Privacy

Privacy policy.

What data BARVIS Studio collects through the enquiry form, why, how long it is kept, who can access it and how to ask for changes or deletion.

Last updated: 26 November 2026.

Who processes the data

The data is processed by Boris Lahos, a private individual from Novi Sad, Serbia, working under the name BARVIS Studio. Contact for any question about your data: hello@barvis-studio.dev.

What I collect

Only what you send yourself through the enquiry, estimate or call request form: your name, email or phone, the chosen service, your message and optional details (budget, timeline, team size, current tools, preferred time).

Each enquiry also records the time it was sent, the language and the page it came from. To prevent abuse, a shortened, irreversibly altered fingerprint of the IP address (not the address itself) and the browser identifier are stored.

The site does not use cookies for tracking, analytics or ads.

Why

To reply to your enquiry, arrange a call and prepare a quote. I do not use the data for advertising and I do not sell it.

How long

Enquiries are kept for 12 months after the last contact and then deleted. You can ask for earlier deletion at any time.

If an enquiry turns into a business relationship, further processing and retention are governed separately, by the contract and legal obligations.

Who has access

Only I have access. Enquiries are stored on my server, and I get a notification of each new enquiry by email (Gmail). The site is static and hosted on GitHub Pages; the form sends the enquiry through a Cloudflare connection directly to my server.

Your rights

You can ask to see your data, correct it or delete it, or ask me to stop using it. Write to hello@barvis-studio.dev; I reply personally.

If you believe your rights have been violated, you can contact the Serbian Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection.

If you write directly

If you contact me by email, WhatsApp or Viber, the rules of those services also apply. I keep such messages for the same 12 months.
